ideas.pitch: An AI-powered visual discovery engine for D2C e-commerce stores that lets shoppers find products using uploaded photos and returns style-matched alternatives with zero latency.
ideas.title: CartGenius VisionSearch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the core theme of product discovery and uses a high-performance computer vision stack similar to CricketVision_AI, proving technical depth within a tight buildathon window.

ideas.pitch: An automated pricing intelligence platform for online marketplace sellers that analyzes competitor pricing graphs and demand signals to optimize real-time inventory pricing.
ideas.title: DynamicPricing Graph Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting seller tools directly addresses B2B pain points for e-commerce merchants, and leveraging graph intelligence mirrors the winning architecture of Bito.

ideas.pitch: An automated e-commerce fraud and fake review detection engine using multi-modal sentiment and behavioral graph tracking to secure online checkout flows.
ideas.title: TrustVerify AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles fraud detection, a high-value priority for online stores and marketplaces, while showcasing robust data modeling techniques proven in winner circles.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI shopping assistant agent that builds hyper-personalized capsule wardrobes for individual shoppers based on past purchases, body types, and contextual browsing.
ideas.title: AuraFit Personal Stylist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the personalized shopping theme by integrating a seamless user-facing experience reminiscent of the winning E-Foodiee Nutrition Assistant.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent delivery and returns logistics coordinator that predicts regional fulfillment bottlenecks and optimizes last-mile routing for e-commerce sellers.
ideas.title: LogiRoute AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on operational logistics, a major real-world pain point for e-commerce, utilizing statistical forecasting calibrated for prediction intervals similar to AI Incident Forecasting.
